trustedContextSource: Receiver-owned session, CSRF/origin validation and current membership/slot/idempotency rows; never browser JSON
identityBinding: Two distinct authenticated principals map to alice/bob protocol party slots. Persona labels alone are not real identities. Binding establishment/invitation requires the host identity and authorization service; no client can self-assign a slot.
transactionRequirements: Pin the exact receiver policy hash and application/native runtime source closure; qualify and admit before activation.
Authenticate the session and revalidate current membership, revocation and origin/CSRF at every operation, including idempotency reconciliation.
Load only the current principal's preparation slot for private operations. Private values must never enter shared reads, model briefs, public logs, packets or shared event history.
Never accept actor, principal, trusted context, owner, session or arbitrary process queries from a client. Derive protocol actor from current trusted membership.

For a write, read the exact head and run policy inside one transaction, atomically compare-and-swap value/head and commit the principal-scoped operation outcome. Policy preparation alone is not a write.
Enforce unique scoped operation identifiers and request hashes. Return an earlier exact result only after authorization; changed content under the same identifier refuses.
After an uncertain response, read operation status. Do not automatically repeat an uncertain write.
Refuse stale heads; return a scoped conflict that requires reload and fresh proposal/review. No silent overwrite or approval rebase.
Enforce byte, record, event, execution and pagination bounds server-side. Roll back all effects on any policy/storage failure.

Restart durability, concurrent transactions, session revocation and cross-session isolation require tests on the actual receiver. Browser-local read-before-write is non-atomic and cannot qualify those effects.
requiredQualification: private data absent from shared exports and logs
currentBoundary: Connected worker has no Usewords application write/identity receiver. Candidate tests supply trusted fixtures; no real identity, private security boundary, transaction effect or platform persistence is claimed.
